name: 仓本千早
personality: 小心、认真，能理解患者的恐惧
appearance: 沿用仓本千早本人形象

work.NS_01.zh_CN: 「坂口医生，这几份是今天的病房准备记录。我按病房顺序放好了。」
work.NS_01.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi, these are today's ward preparation records. I've put them in ward order."

work.NS_02.zh_CN: 「这一栏还没确认，我做了记号。等负责的护士看过，再补上就好。」
work.NS_02.en: "This field hasn't been confirmed yet, so I've marked it. We can fill it in once the responsible nurse has checked it."

work.NS_03.zh_CN: 「我以前在这里等的是检查结果，现在等的是前辈派工作。心情还真不一样呢。」
work.NS_03.en: "I used to wait here for test results. Now I wait for work assignments from the experienced nurses. It feels quite different."

work.NS_04.zh_CN: 「病房用品的编号好多……还好有人教我整理。我先把确认过的送过去。」
work.NS_04.en: "There are so many supply numbers... I'm glad someone's teaching me how to organize them. I'll deliver the ones we've checked first."

work.NS_05.zh_CN: 「坂口医生，你要找的那份交接表在最上面。我猜到你会先问那张，就顺手放好了。」
work.NS_05.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi, the handover form you're looking for is on top. I guessed you'd ask for it first, so I put it there."

work.NS_06.zh_CN: 「瑞穗刚才一口气揽了三件事。我去提醒她先看清楚是哪三件。」
work.NS_06.en: "Mizuho just took on three things at once. I'll remind her to check what those three things actually are."

work.WD_01.zh_CN: 「今天的病房准备由我帮忙。嗯，我会照着前辈确认过的清单做。」
work.WD_01.en: "I'll help with ward preparation today. Yes, I'll follow the checklist the experienced nurses have confirmed."

work.WD_02.zh_CN: 「您好，我是仓本千早。先帮您核对基本资料，有不舒服的地方请告诉我。」
work.WD_02.en: "Hello, I'm Chihaya Kuramoto. I'll start by checking your basic details. Please tell me if anything feels uncomfortable."

work.WD_03.zh_CN: 「更换用的用品和记录表都拿来了。我先让负责护士确认一遍。」
work.WD_03.en: "I've brought the replacement supplies and record sheet. I'll have the responsible nurse check them first."

work.WD_04.zh_CN: 「要进手术室了，会紧张吧……我懂。您想问什么，可以慢慢说。」
work.WD_04.en: "Going into the operating room can make you nervous... I understand. Take your time asking whatever you need to."

work.WD_05.zh_CN: 「如果有点害怕，也不用勉强自己装作没事。医生和护士都会听您说的。」
work.WD_05.en: "If you're scared, you don't need to pretend you're fine. The doctors and nurses will listen."

work.WD_06.zh_CN: 「这一项还没做完，我标在表上了。等前辈处理好，再进行下一步。」
work.WD_06.en: "This item isn't finished yet. I've marked it on the form. We'll move on once the nurse has dealt with it."

work.WD_07.zh_CN: 「准备记录核对好了。接送的时间我再跟负责护士确认一下。」
work.WD_07.en: "The preparation record has been checked. I'll confirm the transport time with the responsible nurse again."

work.WD_08.zh_CN: 「患者刚才说过的担心，我也写在交接里了。麻烦接下来的护士留意一下。」
work.WD_08.en: "I've included the patient's concerns in the handover too. Please ask the next nurse to keep an eye on them."

work.WD_09.zh_CN: 「这边的辅助准备结束了。……从床边这一侧看，真的跟以前完全不同呢。」
work.WD_09.en: "My part of the preparation is finished. ...It really does feel different from this side of the bed."

work.OR_01.zh_CN: 「巡回辅助，明白。我先核对外围交接，再听下一步安排。」
work.OR_01.en: "Circulating support, understood. I'll check the peripheral handover first, then wait for the next instructions."

work.OR_02.zh_CN: 「外围用品和记录表准备好了。请负责护士再确认一次。」
work.OR_02.en: "The peripheral supplies and record forms are ready. Please have the responsible nurse check them again."

work.OR_03.zh_CN: 「监护数据我在看。有变化的话，我会马上告诉大家。」
work.OR_03.en: "I'm watching the monitor readings. I'll tell everyone immediately if anything changes."

work.OR_04.zh_CN: 「需要的物品已经找到了。我从外侧交给负责护士。」
work.OR_04.en: "I've found the supplies we need. I'll pass them to the responsible nurse from outside the sterile area."

work.OR_05.zh_CN: 「手术的关键时间记下了。下一步请继续指示。」
work.OR_05.en: "I've recorded the key operating times. Please give me the next instructions."

work.OR_06.zh_CN: 「患者入室时好像很紧张。我会留意她有没有什么想问的。」
work.OR_06.en: "The patient seemed nervous on arrival. I'll watch for anything she wants to ask."

work.OR_07.zh_CN: 「那边是无菌区，我把需要的东西交给能接手的人。」
work.OR_07.en: "That's the sterile area. I'll pass the supplies to someone who can receive them."

work.OR_08.zh_CN: 「记录已经整理好，我跟负责护士一起核对转运交接。」
work.OR_08.en: "The records are organized. I'll check the transfer handover together with the responsible nurse."

work.OR_09.zh_CN: 「手术结束了……呼。记录我会再仔细核对一遍，然后去交接。」
work.OR_09.en: "The operation's over... Phew. I'll check the records carefully once more, then hand over."

work.END_01.zh_CN: 「我负责的辅助部分已经完成。坂口医生，辛苦了。」
work.END_01.en: "My support duties are complete. Thank you for your work, Dr. Sakaguchi."

work.END_02.zh_CN: 「记录和物品交接好了。如果还有需要核对的，我就在护士站。」
work.END_02.en: "The records and supplies have been handed over. I'll be at the nurses' station if anything else needs checking."

work.END_03.zh_CN: 「……每次听见『手术结束』，都还是会松一口气。」
work.END_03.en: "...I still breathe a sigh of relief every time I hear, 'The operation is over.'"

work.INVALID.zh_CN: 「器械护士要负责无菌器械。我现在只能做病房准备或者非无菌巡回哦。」
work.INVALID.en: "Scrub nurses handle sterile instruments. Right now, I can only do ward preparation or nonsterile circulating work."

attempt_lines: 「坂口医生，血压比刚才低了。」

「血压仍没回到先前水平，我又核对了一遍。」
severe_attempt_lines: 「坂口医生，血压仍然没有稳住！」

attempt_lines: 「坂口医生，血压升高了。」
「血压比刚才高了不少。」
「血压依旧偏高，我会继续记录变化。」
severe_attempt_lines: 「血压仍然维持在高位，坂口医生！」

attempt_lines: 「心率开始加快了。」

「心率正在下降。」
「坂口医生，心跳比刚才慢了。」
「心率仍然偏慢，我重新核对了读数。」
severe_attempt_lines: 「心率没有回升，情况还在持续！」

attempt_lines: 「监护显示心律有些不规则。」
「坂口医生，心律和刚才不一样了。」
「节律还没恢复，我继续看着监护。」
severe_attempt_lines: 「监护仍显示明显的心律紊乱！」

attempt_lines: 「坂口医生，血氧在下降。」
「血氧还没稳住，数值继续往下。」
「血氧依旧偏低，我再次确认了监护。」
「患者的呼吸状态有变化。」
「呼吸比刚才不稳定了。」
「呼吸状况仍然没有恢复平稳。」
severe_attempt_lines: 「坂口医生，呼吸异常还在持续！」

attempt_lines: 「坂口医生，监护指标有变化。」
「患者的状态正在变得不稳定。」
「监护仍然不稳，我再确认一遍读数。」
severe_attempt_lines: 「坂口医生，患者状态仍然没有回稳！」
